_: Demo data for ?demo=1. The people, finds, swaps, fit checks and designs sent in are invented; vintage.js adds them to the demo boards (boards-fake.js), which already holds three of the finds and one of the swaps by title. The shops are the first fourteen of data/vintage-shops.json (downtown, the Waterfront and the South End) and the designs six of all-day/data/merch-designs.json, copied as they are, so the demo never shows an hour or an address that is not real. days is how long a post has left; photo is a placeholder palette. New in: instagram names the invented shop accounts as data/vintage-shops.json names the real ones, and instagramPosts are invented posts in all-day/data/instagram.json's shape; their times move with the reader's clock (anchor). One post is three weeks old and one is from an account that is not a shop: neither shows. A shop's photo in the demo is a placeholder palette credited to the real shop's page; the rest show their initials tile.
